headline: Ceigall India Share Price: Ceigall Wins ₹609 Crore REC Power Project in Gujarat-Maharashtra, Shares Rise 4%
summary: Ceigall India won a bid as L1 bidder for a 'Common Transmission System' from REC Power Development and Consultancy worth 6086.70 million rupees. The company's shares rose 4%.
why: Ceigall India is an Indian infrastructure construction company, and its order wins show the flow of new government-linked project work. Large contract awards can affect revenue visibility for mid-cap builders.
